column7: The phrase **“I AM THAT I AM”** (Ehyeh-Asher-Ehyeh) is one of the most profound self-revelations in Scripture. When Moses asks for God’s name, God responds with this phrase, which can be translated as "I Am Who I Am," "I Will Be Who I Will Be," or simply "I Am." This declaration on the surface is a bit confusing but holds deep meaning. Could you imagine introducing yourself to someone new as ‘I am’? When God reveals Himself as ‘I AM THAT I AM’ He is attesting to His nature, His eternal presence, His sovereignty. ‘I am’ is infinite in meaning and purpose.
